about: FOOD-SCORE-BE (agent 192): the foods clients log most, each with the words typed, a rule for the right first result, a portion and the right calories for it. kcal is for the portion: source kcal per 100 g x grams / 100, or the brand's stated kcal for one item. A row scores when FoodService.search's first result meets name_rule (every 'all' pattern and no 'none' pattern, case-insensitive, on name + brand) and its kcal for the portion is within 10% of kcal.
chosen_how: Hand-picked on 2026-11-02, no client log data was read. 7 foods the owner named first (eggs, bacon, ham, white rice, sausage, steak, chicken breast; 4 of them are built-in foods); then the rest of the 65 built-in foods (prisma/data/seed-foods.json), each with the plain words a client types for it; then 24 more plain everyday foods the built-in list lacks (cuts, deli meat, cooked eggs, fish, breads, sides, fruit, juice, pizza and fries); then 8 chain-restaurant items, marked v11 (v1.1, printed but never failing).
recorded_note: recorded=false: no saved USDA/Open Food Facts answer yet (USDA DEMO_KEY limit, ruling from /root 11-02). Such a row is printed as 'not recorded' and left out of the score and the floor.
